svg.title: Hybrid private endpoint DNS resolution
svg.desc: An on-premises client asks its DNS server, which conditionally forwards blob.core.windows.net over VPN or ExpressRoute to the DNS Private Resolver inbound endpoint. The resolver asks Azure DNS, which follows the public CNAME and answers from the private DNS zone linked to the hub. The client then connects to the private endpoint IP over VPN or ExpressRoute.
svg.text: Client connects to 10.2.1.5 over VPN / ExpressRoute
